findings.title: 'C87 / EN never exceeds the divider's 2.03 V' is stated as an absolute in seven records, beside 'EN stays <= 2.06 V' in the same files; it is a nominal, intact-R81 figure

evidence.files: STATUS.md line 18; AGENTS.md line 13; docs/M3_R10.md lines 42 and 259; docs/R10_VALIDATION.md line 1859 (owner row 29); docs/FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md line 36; parts_qualification.md line 24 (also R10_DECISIONS D-R21-05 'never charges above')
evidence.same_files_other_figure: STATUS line 19, M3_R10 line 149, R10_VALIDATION line 1806, parts_qualification line 24: 'EN stays <= 2.06 V' (round 21 circuit check)
evidence.calculation: 8.4 V x 300k / (300k + 940k) = 2.032 V nominal; with 1 % resistors 8.4 x 303 / (303 + 930.6) = 2.063 V. Both hold only with R81 intact: an R81 open (body or joint) lets C87 and EN charge toward BAT_IN through R80 + R165 (940 kOhm) with J400 closed, as on every revision (Inference from the circuit; TI SLVSFC9C section 6.1 p7 EN/UVLO abs max 6.5 V).
evidence.ambiguity: parts_qualification line 24: 'EN stays <= 2.06 V (8 % of rating)' directly after the 6.5 V EN rating; 2.06 / 6.5 = 32 %, 2.06 / 25 V (C87's rating) = 8 %
evidence.rule: AGENTS section 2.5 (a calculation or inference must not be written as an unconditional fact)

findings.impact: Readers get two different bounds for the same node, and 'never' reads as a fault-independent guarantee. No design change follows; the D-R21-05 argument (no C87-to-EN dump after an open between them) is unaffected.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only. In each listed place: 'EN never exceeds the divider's 2.03 V' -> 'EN stays at the divider's 2.03 V nominal (<= 2.06 V with 1 % parts, at 8.4 V; Calculation) while R81 is intact'. parts_qualification: '(8 % of rating)' -> '(8 % of C87's 25 V rating)'.
